venues.trending_copy: Lambton's Elder St line forms before CRUMB's doors open most mornings, mostly for whichever croissant variant has landed on the counter that day. Get there before the cookies sell through — they hold up better than the timing suggests.
venues.must_try: Creative croissants, gooey cookies, hot or iced matcha, freshly baked pastries (arrive early!)

venues.trending_copy: Hunter is the Newcastle bakery name TikTok keeps surfacing this fortnight, ahead of any writeups. Worth a walk past on a weekday morning before the rest of the FYP cycle catches on.
